parameters.responseBody:
=={{
JSON.stringify({
  recall: {
    query:
      $input.all()[0]
        .json.query,

    selected: {
      title:
        $input.all()[0]
          .json.name,

      documentId:
        $input.all()[0]
          .json.id,

      score:
        $input.all()[0]
          .json.score,

      modifiedTime:
        new Date(
          $input.all()[0]
            .json.modifiedTime
        ).toLocaleString(
          "en-MY",
          {
            year: "numeric",
            month: "2-digit",
            day: "2-digit",
            hour: "numeric",
            minute: "2-digit",
            hour12: true
          }
        ),

      reasons:
        $input.all()[0]
          .json.reasons,

      preview:
        $input.all()[0]
          .json.preview
    },

    related:
      $input.all()
        .slice(1)
        .map(item => ({

          title:
            item.json.name,

          documentId:
            item.json.id,

          score:
            item.json.score,

          modifiedTime:
            new Date(
              item.json
                .modifiedTime
            ).toLocaleString(
              "en-MY",
              {
                year:
                  "numeric",
                month:
                  "2-digit",
                day:
                  "2-digit"
              }
            ),

          preview:
            item.json.preview

        }))
  }
}, null, 2)
}}
